question: Is OLA-001's chance-level definition result a fact about the learner or a fact about the harness, and if the frame is taught does the lexical knowledge already read turn out to be reachable?
frozen_before: any weight moved and before the OLA-001 blocked and disconnected arms reported

starting_checkpoint.arm_selected_by: the OLA-001 frozen decision rule, not by inspection: connected if it beats blocked on held-out dev mean next-token NLL at equal steps and on descartes transfer, otherwise blocked
starting_checkpoint.rationale: the question is whether knowledge already read becomes reachable once the frame is taught, so the comparison is on one set of parameters

change.kind: an additional training view of dictionary entries already in the training split
change.rendering: <def> + definition words capped at 40 + <is> + headword + <eos>, built directly as ids from the frozen vocabulary
change.eligible_entries: split == train, single-word headword present in the frozen vocabulary, definition at least 6 words
change.ola_001_remains_restorable_because: each OLA-001 checkpoint carries its own language_config and restore_descendant reinstates it; the restore report states code_unchanged_since_training false rather than hiding it

arms.name: unframed
arms.view: definition body alone, exactly as OLA-001
arms.role: format control; is any gain just more webster training?

steps_rationale: matched to one OLA-001 stage so the additional teaching is bounded and comparable to the original definitions stage

preconditions.check: the <def> and <is> rows of lex_embedding in the selected OLA-001 checkpoint are bit-identical to what LanguageAcquisitionR1.attach produces at the recorded seed
preconditions.if_it_fails: the diagnosis is wrong and this protocol is withdrawn, not adjusted

preconditions.check: no framed item's entry has split dev or final
the vocabulary digest after adding the view equals 78cb571df98221c676f2168adb2616e35aded70ad0c1b5f02c3efd833dec443c

acceptance.frame_supported_if: framed dev definition accuracy exceeds 0.1659 (chance + 3 sd) and exceeds unframed by more than 0.0385 (2 sd of the difference)
acceptance.frame_rejected_if: framed does not exceed 0.1659; reported as a negative result about the architecture at this capacity, not about the harness
acceptance.diagnosis_rejected_if: unframed also exceeds 0.1659; the gain would then be extra webster exposure rather than the frame
acceptance.retention_guard: dev cloze must not fall by more than 0.02, dev mean next-token NLL must not rise by more than 2 percent against the starting checkpoint, and every case of the declared 33-task retained suite must still answer; a breach is a failed repair even if the definition number rises
acceptance.generalisation_check: descartes transfer cloze measured before and after and reported either way; it has never been trained on in any protocol

sealed_split.reason: OLA-001 opens final exactly once; opening it again would make it a split that has been looked at twice
sealed_split.consequence_stated_honestly: OLA-002's evidence is developmental - dev, never trained on but used for OLA-001's curve, and descartes transfer, never used for anything. Confirming OLA-002 on a genuinely sealed split needs a split that does not yet exist.
